resolvedBy.note: G-aem: the source's schema.org graph (WebSite/Person/WebPage) is emitted at runtime by decorateJsonLd() from scripts/site-config.js; the static detector reads fetched HTML and cannot see it. Re-runs of optimize.mjs will re-detect it as open unless the detector renders — see stardust/learnings.md.
